clue.text: Making public announcements diverting as can be

indicators.note: the letters of the two words before it show what they can be when rearranged

explanation.surface: Public announcements are as entertaining as they could possibly be.
explanation.walkthrough: 'diverting' looks like praise for the announcements; with 'as' it is the fodder, and 'can be' tells you to rearrange the eleven letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Advertising is the business of putting out notices to catch the public's attention.

clue.text: Judge taking part in rare settlement

indicators.note: one piece takes the other into its middle, holding it
a settlement is an arrangement reached, so the word rare is rearranged

parts.note: a bit is a part of something

explanation.surface: A judge has a role in an unusual legal settlement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'settlement' rearranges RARE into ARER, and 'taking' has that hold BIT; 'in' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: An arbiter decides a dispute, acting as a judge between the parties.

clue.text: Set against foreign language poetry

parts.note: V, short for versus, means set against, as in a match
Erse is the Gaelic language of Ireland or Scotland

explanation.surface: Poetry in another tongue is set against English.
explanation.walkthrough: V is the usual abbreviation of versus; ERSE is the Gaelic of Ireland and Scotland.
explanation.definitionFit: Verse is writing in metre, the form of poems as opposed to prose.

clue.text: Doesn't forget about arms?

parts.note: re is a common word for about or concerning
arms are limbs, and limbs are members of the body

explanation.surface: Someone keeps in mind something about weapons.
explanation.walkthrough: 'arms' suggests weapons, but here it means limbs, which are members of the body.
explanation.definitionFit: To recall something is to keep it in mind, the opposite of losing it from memory.

clue.text: Greek character involved in a riot-an agitator

indicators.note: the letters are wrapped up inside the words that follow

explanation.surface: A Greek figure is caught up in a riot started by a troublemaker.
explanation.definitionFit: Iota is the ninth letter of the Greek alphabet.

clue.text: Putting one right, go on about it and cause annoyance

parts.note: the Roman numeral for one is I

indicators.note: one piece goes around the other

parts.note: to rate someone is to scold them, to go on at them
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone correcting another person keeps nagging about it and becomes a nuisance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'go on' is used in the sense of going on at someone, nagging or berating them; 'about' signals the container.
explanation.definitionFit: To irritate is to vex or annoy someone.

clue.text: Note water is needed for cereal production

parts.note: G is a note of the musical scale
rain is water falling from the sky

explanation.surface: A farmer notes that rain is needed to grow cereals.
explanation.definitionFit: Grain is the harvested seed that cereal crops produce.

clue.text: A supporter of solid fuel

parts.note: reads like a campaigner for coal, but means an iron stand that holds logs up in a hearth

explanation.surface: Someone backs coal and wood over other kinds of energy.
explanation.definitionFit: A firedog, or andiron, is one of a pair of metal stands that hold logs in a fireplace.

clue.text: Having the same natural gift

parts.note: do is short for ditto, meaning the same again
native means natural or inborn, as a native talent

explanation.surface: Two people share the same inborn talent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'natural gift' reads as one phrase, but 'natural' gives NATIVE and 'gift' alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A donative is a donation or present, especially an official one.

clue.text: Working under pressure indicates impending changes

definitions.text: Working under pressure indicates impending changes

parts.words: Working under pressure indicates impending changes
parts.note: reads like a stressed employee giving warning, but describes an instrument driven by air pressure that forecasts the weather

explanation.surface: An overworked employee signals that a shake-up is coming.
explanation.definitionFit: A barometer measures atmospheric pressure, and its readings show coming shifts in the weather.

clue.text: Love-love in a strange retreat

indicators.note: one piece is placed inside the other
to retreat is to go back, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: rum is a British word for odd or strange
love is zero in tennis scoring, which looks like the letter O

explanation.surface: Love blooms in an odd hideaway.
explanation.definitionFit: Amour is a love affair, from the French for passion.

clue.text: Hamlet upset the girl

indicators.note: upset means knocked over or disordered, so the letters of the name are jumbled

explanation.surface: Shakespeare's Prince of Denmark upsets a young woman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hamlet' suggests the play, or a small village; it is just the fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: Thelma is a woman's first name.

clue.text: Colours, being normal

explanation.surface: A flag that is entirely ordinary.
explanation.definitionFit: A standard is a banner, as colours are; and standard also means the usual or regular kind.

clue.text: Rows occasioned by out-moded kitchen equipment

definitions.meaning: rows are lines, as in mountain chains
old-fashioned cooking stoves heated by solid fuel

explanation.surface: Quarrels broke out over old-fashioned cooking appliances.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rows' looks like quarrels; it means lines.
explanation.definitionFit: Ranges are rows or lines of things, and a range is also an old cast-iron kitchen stove.

clue.text: Salesmen should be anonymous

indicators.note: the letters of the word should be made into something else

explanation.surface: Sales staff ought to keep their names to themselves.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone anonymous has no known name.

clue.text: Socialist leader listing beastly accommodation

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its first letter

parts.note: tabling means setting out in a table or list

explanation.surface: A left-wing party chief draws up a list.
explanation.walkthrough: 'beastly' sounds like an insult; here it means for beasts, animals.
explanation.definitionFit: Stabling is housing for horses and other animals.

clue.text: Game beauty toting a gun

indicators.note: toting means carrying, so one piece holds the other

parts.note: a belle is a beautiful woman
gat is American slang for a gun

explanation.surface: A lovely woman carries a pistol as part of a game.
explanation.definitionFit: Bagatelle is a table game in which balls are struck into holes, a forerunner of pinball.

clue.text: Wild duck-a beautiful pink bird

parts.note: flaming means fiercely passionate, wild with feeling
a duck, a score of nothing in cricket, looks like the letter O

explanation.surface: An angry duck turns out to be a lovely pink bird.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Wild duck' looks like one phrase; split it.
explanation.definitionFit: The flamingo is a tall wading bird with rosy plumage.

clue.text: Many a mole is required to make such wear for women

parts.note: C, the Roman numeral for a hundred, stands for many

indicators.note: the letters are used to make something new, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: Lots of moles are needed to make a ladies' garment from their skins.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mole' suggests moleskin; it is only letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A camisole is a light sleeveless undergarment worn by women.

clue.text: Starting counting bids for the strongboxes

indicators.note: the start of the next word means its first letter

parts.note: offers are bids made for something

explanation.surface: At the start of the count, bids are made for the safes.
explanation.definitionFit: Coffers are chests for keeping money and valuables safe.

clue.text: A repugnant characteristic, that's not disputed

parts.note: greed is a vice, an unpleasant trait

explanation.surface: Everyone accepts that avarice is an ugly trait.
explanation.definitionFit: Something accepted by all sides is settled, not argued over.

clue.text: Merit of French translation of 2 down

parts.note: de is the French word for of

indicators.note: a translation turns words into a different form, so the letters are reordered

parts.note: the answer to 2 down

explanation.surface: A French translation of a poem is worth something.
explanation.walkthrough: 'translation' suggests French again, but here it rearranges VERSE (the answer to 2 down) into SERVE.
explanation.definitionFit: To deserve is to merit, to have earned something.

clue.text: Rant about reform till the end

indicators.note: one piece goes around the other

parts.note: to fume is to rage or rant

indicators.note: to reform is to form again, so the letters are reshaped

explanation.surface: A protester rails about reform right up to the finish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reform' is the anagram signal and 'about' the container; full time is the final whistle in football.
explanation.definitionFit: Full time is the close of a sports match, when the final whistle blows.

clue.text: Provide medical attention-something quite special

definitions.meaning: to care for a patient as a doctor

explanation.surface: A doctor's care feels like a rare indulgence.
explanation.definitionFit: Doctors treat patients, and a treat is also a special pleasure.

clue.text: Standing for a good man at American get-together

parts.note: St is short for saint, a good man
taken as written

explanation.surface: Respect is earned by a decent man at a meeting in America.
explanation.definitionFit: Status is someone's rank or position in society.

clue.text: He wrote 2 down to accommodate a fool

indicators.note: to accommodate is to house, so one piece holds the other

parts.note: taken as written
an ass is a fool

explanation.surface: A poet made room in his verse for a fool.
explanation.walkthrough: Torquato Tasso was an Italian Renaissance poet, author of Jerusalem Delivered. The first 'to' is part of the indicator.
explanation.definitionFit: Tasso was a sixteenth-century Italian poet famous for his epic poetry.

clue.text: A fish month for Jews

parts.note: the bib, or pouting, is a small fish of the cod family

explanation.surface: A certain fish is eaten in a Jewish month.
explanation.definitionFit: Abib is the old biblical name of the first month of the Hebrew calendar, later called Nisan.

clue.text: Proceed to prosecute on certain points

indicators.note: one piece comes on after the other

parts.note: E and N are points of the compass, east and north
to sue is to take someone to court

explanation.surface: Go ahead and take legal action on certain grounds.
explanation.walkthrough: 'points' suggests legal points; it means compass points.
explanation.definitionFit: To ensue is to follow on or come next, as events proceed.

clue.text: Very little drops from this

parts.note: reads as hardly anything falling out, but means tiny droplets are produced by the device

explanation.surface: Hardly anything ever comes out of this.
explanation.definitionFit: A nebuliser turns liquid medicine into a fine mist of droplets to be inhaled.

clue.text: Trying to procure foreign currency in great volume

indicators.note: one piece is placed inside the other

parts.note: a tome is a large heavy book
roubles are the currency of Russia

explanation.surface: Someone attempts to get plenty of foreign money.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Trying' looks like making an attempt; it means irksome.
explanation.definitionFit: Something trying is difficult and wearing, a nuisance.
